summary: The Federal Home Loan Bank of New York filed an 8-K solely to attach its monthly President's Report to shareholders. The report discloses routine second-quarter operating results—$153.3 million net income, $27.5 million allocated to housing initiatives, and $128 billion in member funding—plus a congressional hearing note. No merger, tender offer, restructuring, capital return, or other special-situation event is described. This is a standard informational filing, not a corporate action warranting special-situation classification.
